page.layout: One page: a centred imprint of four lines and a date line, with no other text. A handwritten number at the top right is not printed and is omitted.
page.notes: The handwritten "299" at the top right is a manuscript foliation, not printed, so it is left out. The imprint's U/V and I/J spellings are normalised per the rules (VIDVAM to VIDUAM, MORETVM to MORETUM, IOAN to JOAN). The rest of the page is blank paper, with no catchword, signature or running head.
